method: Wash the vegetables. Chop onion and peppers where listed; slice tomato where listed and keep raw meat preparation separate.

Use half the measured olive oil in a frying pan. Follow the sausage packet cooking guidance. Cook the reduced-fat pork sausages thoroughly, turning regularly. Check the thickest piece is steaming hot through the centre. A clean probe should read 70°C for 2 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate. Slice the cooked sausages before assembling the toastie.
Heat the remaining half of the measured olive oil in the frying pan. Add the tomato, spinach; cook until softened, with spinach wilted and excess liquid evaporated where listed.
Return the fully cooked reduced-fat pork sausages to the pan and heat through.
Stir in the listed flavour ingredients (30g brown sauce), mixing powders and liquids evenly; heat any beans or mushrooms until steaming hot.

Heat the sandwich toaster. Spoon the cooked filling between the measured bread slices, spreading it evenly and keeping wetter ingredients away from the edges. Do not overfill; serve any remaining cooked filling alongside.
Toast for around 4–6 minutes, following the appliance guidance, until the bread is crisp and the filling is steaming hot in the centre. Rest for one minute before cutting.
Serve the toastie with any remaining measured filling. Nutrition includes the whole portion, including the side.

review.notes: Plain crisp wholemeal toastie with sliced fully cooked sausages, softened tomato, wilted spinach and brown sauce. No cheese or garnish; recipe form matches.
